01

Before the cycle

Everything here must be done before the 3rd. Finance (Disha & Takshak) share the property list. Both AM team and Finance verify each property before the cycle runs.

1
Property Commercials
CRM Admin → Property → Property Commercials → Commercials tab

Fill in the revenue split for the property and click Save All Commercials.

Commercials tab — Model and Vista Commission Type highlighted
F&B Model, Owner Bookings commission, and Service Charge fields
FieldWhat to do
MODEL *Set to Revenue Share. Fill in the Sub Type.
VISTA COMMISSION TYPESelect Flat Percentage (%). Do not select Slab-wise Model.
F&B MODELSelect model. Fill Vista Share % and Owner Share %.
OWNER BOOKINGS COMMISSION (%)Enter commission % for owner bookings.
SERVICE CHARGE ON EXPENSESYes or No. If Yes, fill % and any exempted heads.
✕Do not fill Monthly Fixed Fee, Minimum Guarantee, or Slab-wise Model for these properties.
2
Owner Details
Same page → Owner Details tab → click the owner name

The statement will not calculate correctly without these details. Click the owner name to open the pop-up, fill in the fields, and click Save Details.

Owner Details — Stay TDS and Meal TDS (red), PAN Number and GST Applicable (blue)
FieldWhat to do
STAY TDS (%)TDS applicable on stay revenue.
MEAL TDS (%)TDS applicable on meal revenue.
PAN NUMBER *Mandatory — must be filled.
GST APPLICABLEYes or No. If Yes, the GST Number field unlocks — fill it in.
Multiple ownersAdd each owner separately with their split %. Must total 100%.
3
Owner Deductions + Show Statement
Property Details → scroll right → Owner Deductions tab

Set each deduction line item to Show or Hide based on what the owner should see in Alfred. Click Save.

Owner Deductions — Show Statement row highlighted
⚠Show Statement goes live on Alfred the moment you click Save. Only turn it on after Steps 1 and 2 are fully and correctly done. If you do it before, the owner will see an incorrect statement.
4
Commission adjustments — do before the 5th
Any hits on commission, owner referrals, or owner executed bookings must be updated before the email goes out

This reduces corrections after the statement is sent.

Hit on commission

Use when a booking should carry a lower Vista commission than the default.

a
Find the booking → click BD
BD button highlighted in the booking row
b
Scroll to bottom left → Commission Adjustments → enter reduced % → Submit
ℹOnly visible to authorised users. List of authorised users: [add here]. If you can't see it, ask your manager.
Commission Adjustments — Vista Share (%) for Stay and Meals highlighted
✕You can only reduce Vista Share % — not increase beyond the Max shown. The system will block it.

Owner referral bookings

Owner gave the lead, StayVista executed the booking.

  • Open the booking in CRM Admin.
  • Set Primary Source of Contact (POC) to Owner Referral.
  • System calculates Vista's share separately at the referral rate.
⚠If POC is not set to Owner Referral, the owner loses the referral benefit in their payout.

Owner executed bookings

Owner found and ran the booking themselves.

  • Add the booking in CRM Admin normally.
  • Go to the Payments tab of that booking.
  • Mark the entire amount as paid to owner.
ℹDo not use Commission Adjustments for owner executed bookings — use the Payments tab instead.

Setup checklist

  • Business Model = Revenue Share. Sub Type filled. Vista Commission Type = Flat Percentage.
  • F&B Model filled. Vista Share % and Owner Share % entered.
  • Owner Bookings commission % filled.
  • Service Charge on Expenses answered.
  • PAN Number entered under Owner Details.
  • Stay TDS % and Meal TDS % entered.
  • GST Applicable answered. GST Number filled if Yes.
  • Multiple owner splits added (if applicable).
  • Owner Deductions set correctly.
  • Show Statement turned ON — only after all above are done.

03

Owner review

Owner receives the email on the 5th, opens Alfred, and reviews their statement. Two paths from here.

Alfred — Dispute (red) and Approve (green)

At the bottom of the statement screen in Alfred, the owner sees two buttons. They either tap Approve to move to payout, or tap Dispute to raise a concern.

ℹThe owner can also download a PDF of their statement from this screen before deciding.
Approve
Owner taps Approve → goes to Section 4

No action needed from the AM. Flow moves directly to payout (B2C) or invoice upload (B2B). See Section 4.

Dispute
Owner raises a dispute

Owner taps Dispute → fills in concern → attaches files (optional) → taps Submit Dispute.

Raise Statement Dispute form
Dispute History — owner & team thread
⚠The owner is told: disputes reviewed in 3–5 business days and payment may be held. Respond promptly.

The dispute loop

1
Owner submits
Dispute thread created in CRM Admin.
2
Owner confirmed
Push notification + email: "We have received your request."
3
Team notified
Email to invoicing@stayvista.com, partner.care@stayvista.com, and the owner-facing AM.
4
AM responds
Reply from the dispute thread in CRM Admin.
5
Owner notified
Push notification + email with the response.
↺
Loop
Steps 4–5 repeat until the owner is satisfied and taps Approve.
ℹMake sure you are correctly mapped as the owner-facing AM for your properties. If dispute emails are not reaching you, flag to your manager immediately.
⚠There is currently no deadline for the owner to approve. Resolve disputes quickly to avoid payout delays.
04

After approval

Once the owner taps Approve — whether after reviewing directly or after a dispute resolves — the flow splits by owner type.

B2C
B2C owner → straight to payout

No invoice upload needed. Finance initiates payout directly after approval. Owner sees two states in Alfred:

Payment Processing
Payment Credited — UTR shown
B2B
B2B owner → invoice upload required

After approving, the B2B owner must upload their GST invoice before payout can be initiated.

Reviewing state

"We're reviewing your statement"

This is what the B2B owner sees after they approve and upload their invoice. Finance will review it before payout is initiated.

If Finance rejects the invoice

Invoice Rejected

Owner notified via push + email

Alfred shows the rejection reason and a Re-upload button. Owner corrects the invoice and re-uploads. Finance reviews again — this repeats until approved.

Once approved → payout

Payment Processing
Payment Credited — UTR shown

Finance uploads UTR in CRM Admin. Owner is notified via email and push. UTR is visible in Alfred.
